run_lstm_evaluation: run the eval_lstm script to evaluate an LSTM model against a game environment using rlpytorch
load_environment_with_overrides: load the game environment with actor_only override using load_env from rlpytorch
setup_lstm_trainer: setup the LSTMTrainer with a sampler and ModelInterface for actor-only inference
register_actor_callback: register an actor callback function with the game controller to process batches
run_evaluation_iterations: run evaluation iterations by calling GC.Run in a loop over EvalIters
